title_en: Psychology Made Simple (15/20): One Event, Four Reactions
note_en: To say "some… others…", Chinese simply repeats 有的 before each group: 有的人马上举手报名演主角，有的人想了很久 "some raised their hands right away for the lead; others thought it over for a long time." A further group is added with 还有的 (还有的人没问过任何人 "and still others, without asking anyone…"). English switches words (some / others / still others), while Chinese keeps the same 有的 throughout.
